**Patch round addendum** (PR #10301, branch `claude/issue-10221-sys-setting-log-noise`, head `34e7bade9`)

CI's Dogfood Regression Gate caught a real regression in the first version: it cached every `resolveLocalizationContext` outcome (not just the failing/missing-table case) for 30s, so `analytics-timezone.dogfood.test.ts`'s org-timezone write (#1982/#2018 golden regression) was invisible to the very next analytics read until the cache expired.

Fix: narrowed the cache to memoize **only** the case where the read genuinely fails (a backend fault — the case that actually produces #10221's log spam); a successful or legitimately-empty read is never cached and always re-reads, so a settings write is visible immediately, matching pre-existing behavior. Also fixed a `check:query-options-erasure` hit the first patch introduced (a redundant `as any` on the new inlined query's options literal — `ql` is already typed `any`, so it added nothing and was a newly-counted erasure site).

Added two unit tests pinning the never-cache-a-success guarantee directly at the `resolveLocalizationContext` boundary. The dogfood package's own rig needs a from-scratch build of its ~26-package `@objectstack/*` dependency closure (this worktree had none of it built) — judged too heavy for local verification here and left to CI, per the escalation's own allowance.

`@objectstack/core`'s full suite: 875/875 passed at the new head. Full detail in the updated PR body and the JSON below.
